questions.question: At Mount Sinai, the LORD reminded Israel how He brought them out of Egypt. What picture did He use?

answers.text: He carried them on eagles' wings
He carried them in a shepherd's arms
He carried them in a swift chariot

questions.question: At Mount Sinai, the LORD said that if Israel obeyed Him, what would they be out of all the nations?
On the morning of the third day at Mount Sinai, what broke out over the mountain as Israel waited?
When God met with Israel at Mount Sinai, why was the whole mountain covered in smoke?

answers.text: The LORD came down on it in fire
The people burned offerings on it
Lightning set its trees on fire
